verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for an authenticator app, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics or usage tracking, or any switch to disable them. The offline 'Use without backups' mode and end-to-end encryption are related privacy features, not a telemetry opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
